data: Apple (AAPL) delivered modest top-line progress in fiscal 2024, with revenue rising 2.0% to $391.0 billion from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Profitability moved the other way. Net income fell 3.4% to $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023, so growth did not reach the bottom line. Cash generation remained a clear strength: operating cash flow increased to $118.3 billion in fiscal 2024 from $110.5 billion in fiscal 2023, comfortably exceeding reported net income. The balance sheet expanded, with total assets reaching $365.0 billion in fiscal 2024 versus $352.6 billion in fiscal 2023. Total liabilities grew faster, to $308.0 billion from $290.4 billion. Cash and cash equivalents were essentially flat at $29.9 billion in fiscal 2024 against $30.0 billion in fiscal 2023. Overall, Apple's cash engine is intact, though earnings momentum softened.
